text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...And here I thought this distance was
my forte.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm still not good enough to
catch up to
her...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I knew I was fast!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I'm still not nearly as good as Prez.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can be even faster! Because I'm me... I'm the Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gotta get practicing. My next race is
coming up
soon! Go, go, go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She seriously makes me feel so far
behind...
